assertion_source:
!(assertEqualToResult
  (match &self ($who is a $what) ($who the $what))
  ((Sam the frog)
   (Tom the cat)
   (Sophia the robot)))
author_expected_expression:
((Sam the frog)
   (Tom the cat)
   (Sophia the robot))

assertion_source:
!(assertEqualToResult
  (match &self (:= (Green $who) T) ($who is really green))
  ((Sam is really green)))

!(assertEqualToResult
  (match &self (:= ($color $who) T) ($who is really $color))
  ((Sam is really Green)
   (Tom is really White)))
author_expected_expression:
((Sam is really Green)
   (Tom is really White))

assertion_source:
!(assertEqualToResult
  (match &self (:= ($color $who) $tv) (It's $tv that $who is $color))
  ((It's T that Sam is Green)
   (It's T that Tom is White)
   (It's F that Tom is Green)))
author_expected_expression:
((It's T that Sam is Green)
   (It's T that Tom is White)
   (It's F that Tom is Green))

assertion_source:
!(assertEqualToResult
  (match &self
    (implies ($P $x) (Green Sam))
    ($x might be $P))
  ((Sam might be Frog)))

!(assertEqualToResult
  (match &self
    (, (implies ($P $x) (Green $x))
       (implies ($P $x) (Eats-flies $x)))
    (Then it is definitely $P))
  ((Then it is definitely Frog)))

!(assertEqualToResult
   (expression without known equalities)
  ((expression without known equalities)))

!(assertEqual
  (explain (Evaluation (mortal Plato)))
  ((mortal Plato)
    proven by ((human Plato)
      proven by (And
        (philosopher Plato)
        (likes-to-wrestle Plato)))))
author_expected_expression:
((mortal Plato)
    proven by ((human Plato)
      proven by (And
        (philosopher Plato)
        (likes-to-wrestle Plato))))

assertion_source:
!(assertEqualToResult
  (rev A (superpose (B C D)))
  ((B A) (C A) (D A)))

!(assertEqualToResult
  (Add S Z)
  ((Error (Add S Z) (BadArgType 1 Nat (-> Nat Nat)))))

!(assertEqualToResult
   (Cons (S Z) (Cons Z Nil))
  ((Cons (S Z) (Cons Z Nil))))

!(assertEqualToResult
  (Cons S (Cons Z Nil))
  ((Error (Cons S (Cons Z Nil)) (BadArgType 2 (List (-> Nat Nat)) (List Nat)))))
author_expected_expression: ((Error (Cons S (Cons Z Nil)) (BadArgType 2 (List (-> Nat Nat)) (List Nat))))

assertion_source:
!(assertEqualToResult
  (eq Z S)
  ((Error (eq Z S) (BadArgType 2 Nat (-> Nat Nat)))))

!(assertEqualToResult
  (of-same-type Green Color)
  ((Error (of-same-type Green Color) (BadArgType 2 Color Property))))

!(assertEqualToResult
  (of-same-type Green Circle)
  ((Error (of-same-type Green Circle) (BadArgType 2 Color Shape))))

!(assertEqual
  (let* (($r1 (Add Z Z))
         ($r2 (Add $r1 (S Z)))
         ($r3 (Add $r2 (S Z))))
        (match &self (= (eq (S (S Z)) $r3) $tv) $tv))
  T)

!(assertEqualToResult
    (eqa Z (Add Z Z))
   ((eqa Z (Add Z Z))))

!(assertEqualToResult
   (== SocratesIsHuman SamIsMortal)
  ((Error (== SocratesIsHuman SamIsMortal) (BadArgType 2 (Human Socrates) (Mortal Sam)))))
